name: The Ruins of Stardust
summary: Pelturas Whitemoon's desperate quest to heal his daughter Relara continues in Astranaar. While the sacred water of Elune's Tear calmed her terrifying nightmares, a fierce fever still grips her. Guided by Orendil Broadleaf's botanical knowledge, adventurers journey south to harvest a cooling, luminescent dust settled among ancient night elven stones.

sections.title: A Father's Lingering Despair
sections.body: Pelturas Whitemoon has spent sleepless nights by the bedside of his daughter, Relara, watching a malignant affliction burn through her. Though offering an Elune's Tear provided a temporary respite from the tormenting dreams that plagued her thoughts, the illness remains deeply rooted. Her body is racked by an intense fever that mundane medicines have failed to quench. With the temple healers pushed to their limits, Pelturas turns once more to ancient, nature-infused remedies to preserve his daughter's life.

sections.title: The Glint of Stardust
sections.body: On the advice of the elder herbalist Orendil Broadleaf, Pelturas looks toward the Ruins of Stardust, located south across the river from Astranaar. The fallen marble columns and archways of this ancient kaldorei sanctuary harbor a peculiar phenomenon: a frosted, shimmering substance that settles over the local foliage. This powdered condensation, colloquially termed stardust, possesses natural cooling properties potent enough to draw out unnatural heat. Pelturas intends to grind the collected residue into a medicinal poultice, hoping its tranquil chill will finally break Relara's burning fever.

sections.title: Prowlers in the Waters
sections.body: Harvesting the frosted dust is perilous due to the guardians and wildlife inhabiting the flooded, sunken stones. Water elementals, corrupted or agitated by shifts in Ashenvale's balance, surge around the sunken plazas where the bushes grow thickest. Harvesters must wade into the tranquil-looking shallows while staying alert to sudden ambushes from the murky depths, scouring sparkling bushes for enough clean residue before rushing it back to Astranaar.

faq.answer: Pelturas Whitemoon's daughter, Relara, is dying of a severe magical or corrupted fever in Astranaar. While Elune's Tear eased her dark nightmares, her fever still rages unchecked. The elder herbalist Orendil advised that the frosted residue gathering in the Ruins of Stardust has potent cooling properties that can be crafted into a soothing poultice.

faq.q: Where are the Ruins of Stardust located?
faq.answer: The Ruins of Stardust lie directly south of Astranaar in central Ashenvale, situated around a small lake and surrounded by ancient, overgrown kaldorei masonry.

faq.q: What is stardust in this context?
faq.answer: Pelturas hopes the cooling frosted dust from the lake's vegetation can be used in a poultice to lower his daughter's fever.

faq.q: Does the stardust cure Relara completely?
faq.answer: The poultice helps reduce Relara's raging fever, stabilizing her condition in the short term. However, it does not completely banish the deep-seated corruption affecting her body, forcing Pelturas to seek further aid at Fallen Sky Lake.

faq.q: What threats are found at the Ruins of Stardust?
aliases: what attacks at ruins of stardust
faq.answer: The flooded ruins are inhabited by aggressive water elementals that lurk beneath the surface and defend the tranquil waters, posing a danger to anyone wading through the shallows to inspect the shimmering bushes.

Orendil Broadleaf is a knowledgeable night elf herbalist residing in northern Ashenvale near Maestra's Post. He has studied the region's unique plants for centuries and advises Pelturas on rare botanical treatments when standard temple remedies fall short.

angles.text: The ruins scattered south of Astranaar are relics of ancient kaldorei civilization, reminding night elves that the magic lingering in the stones can still be marshaled for healing.
While Elune's grace soothed Relara's nightmares, the physical body often demands earthly remedies alongside divine prayer to preserve mortal life.
The collection of sparkling powder from the brush showcases the specialized knowledge required to identify rare botanical phenomena in Ashenvale's damp microclimates.
Gathering soothing stardust requires contending with the perturbed water spirits inhabiting the flooded ruins, a stark reminder of Ashenvale's fragile ecological harmony.
